items.title: Source: Browns to sign ex-Packers G/C Jenkins
items.description: Offensive lineman Elgton Jenkins is signing a two-year deal with the Browns one day after he was released by the Packers, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Tuesday.

items.title: Snell, FB who helped Jets win SB III, dies at 84
items.description: Matt Snell, a three-time Pro Bowl fullback who scored the only touchdown in the Jets' upset of the Colts in Super Bowl III, died of natural causes Tuesday at age 84.

items.title: Texans make Fairbairn NFL's highest-paid kicker
items.description: Houston's Ka'imi Fairbairn agreed to a two-year, $13 million extension, making him the highest-paid kicker in NFL history, his agency Athletes First announced Tuesday.

items.title: Giants address CB need, agree to sign Newsome
items.description: The Giants addressed their need at cornerback, agreeing with Greg Newsome II on a one-year deal worth up to $10 million, his agents told ESPN.

items.title: Source: Lions add RB Pacheco to pair with Gibbs
items.description: The Lions are signing Isiah Pacheco, giving the team a new running back to pair with Jahmyr Gibbs, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Texans bolster O-line, reach deal with OT Smith
items.description: Free agent offensive tackle Braden Smith reached agreement with the Houston Texans on a two-year, $25 million contract that includes $13.5 million fully guaranteed, his agent told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Sources: TE Knox stays with Bills on new deal
items.description: The Bills found a way to keep tight end Dawson Knox on the 2026 roster amid a difficult cap situation by signing him to a new three-year contract, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler on Tuesday.

items.title: Source: WR Raymond leaves Lions to join Bears
items.description: Kalif Raymond has agreed to sign a one-year contract with the Bears, reuniting the wide receiver with Ben Johnson, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

items.title: Star WR Evans leaving Bucs to sign with 49ers
items.description: Star wide receiver Mike Evans is leaving the Buccaneers to sign a three-year deal with the 49ers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Sources: Ravens nixed Crosby deal after physical
items.description: The Ravens have "backed out" of their agreement to acquire five-time Pro Bowl defensive end Maxx Crosby, with sources telling ESPN that medical concerns arose after a physical.

items.title: Sources: Jets get their QB, trade for Geno Smith
items.description: The Jets are trading for the Raiders' Geno Smith, reuniting the quarterback with the team that drafted him in 2013, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Tuesday.

items.title: Eagles strike, add CB Woolen on one-year deal
items.description: Free agent cornerback Riq Woolen reached agreement Tuesday on a one-year deal worth up to $15 million with the Eagles, agent Jason Chayut told ESPN.

items.title: Sources: Steelers keep Heyward on 1-year deal
items.description: The Steelers and longtime defensive captain Cameron Heyward agreed to a one-year extension, Heyward's agent told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Sources: Saints, LB Elliss reunite on 3-year deal
items.description: The Saints have agreed to a three-year, $33 million deal with linebacker Kaden Elliss, according to NFL Network. Originally drafted by New Orleans, Elliss has spent the past three seasons with the Falcons.

items.title: Source: Ricard latest to rejoin Harbaugh in N.Y.
items.description: Former Ravens fullback Patrick Ricard agreed to a two-year deal with the Giants, a source told ESPN.

items.title: Source: Commanders add to D with Chenal deal
items.description: The Commanders have agreed to a reported three-year, $24.75 million deal with linebacker Leo Chenal.
